title: Agent Evals: Finally, With The Map
talk_summary: Speaker presents a taxonomy for agent evals: semantic vs behavioral, single- vs multi-turn, tool use vs planning, grounded in truthfulness and goal achievement. He also stresses cost/latency/step optimization, tracing, offline vs online testing, and optimizing the evaluator LLM itself as 'eval ops'.

takeaways.what_they_do: Evaluate the agent's representations/understanding separately from its actions, tool selection, and task progression.
takeaways.evidence_quote: agent evaluation can be actually neatly divided to the semantic and behavioral parts of what the agents do

takeaways.technique: Labeled defect corpus for reviewer recall
takeaways.what_they_do: Ground truthfulness in reference data and measure whether outputs faithfully relate to that data.
takeaways.evidence_quote: truthfulness is ultimately achiev by grounding uh the representations in your data

takeaways.technique: Track cost, latency, and steps as eval metrics
takeaways.what_they_do: Treat cost, latency, and number of steps as first-class optimization targets alongside goal achievement.
takeaways.evidence_quote: you want to the agent to progress towards its goal as quickly as possible and as cheaply as possible so cost and latency optimization the number of steps optimization

takeaways.what_they_do: Separate development-time offline evaluation from production-time online evaluation.
takeaways.evidence_quote: very important distinction to keep in mind is the offline versus online testing

takeaways.what_they_do: Optimize the evaluator LLM's cost, latency, and uncertainty, not just the agent being evaluated.
takeaways.evidence_quote: you should be actually uh taking into account as early as possible that you are going to need to also optimize the charge itself

takeaways.what_they_do: Measure tool calls and API interactions with traditional software testing methods rather than only LLM judges.
takeaways.evidence_quote: tools are often something as easy as straightforward as like API calls and uh and such things that can actually be just measured separately
